description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering the dashboard layout in the Goteo.org project. It manages sections, includes partials such as styles, scripts, messages, and sidebar headers, and defines the main content structure for the dashboard page.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the overall layout template for the page.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section of the template that can be filled or replaced.

methods.name: supply
methods.description: Provides content to named sections or placeholders within the layout.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Includes partial templates or components into the layout.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Closes the current section or replaces previous content.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends additional content to a section.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves localized or predefined text strings for meta descriptions or other text content.
